title: Cooper–Embree–Ha–Ha–Hoefel lower-bound conjecture for monomial ideals
statement:
Let $I$ be a monomial ideal, and let $\operatorname{big-height}(I)$ denote the maximum of the heights of the associated primes $P\in\operatorname{Ass}(I)$. Write $e=\operatorname{big-height}(I)$, and let $\alpha(I)$ and $\widehat\alpha(I)$ denote the initial degree and Waldschmidt constant of $I$, respectively. **Cooper–Embree–Ha–Ha–Hoefel's conjecture.**

$$
\widehat\alpha(I)\geq\frac{\alpha(I)+e-1}{e}.
$$
 This is a Chudnovsky-like lower bound for the Waldschmidt constant of a monomial ideal, extending the analogous proposed bound for ideals of points in projective space. The supplied text does not indicate whether the conjecture has been resolved.
source_name: Cristiano Bocci, Susan Cooper, Elena Guardo, Brian Harbourne, Mike Janssen, Uwe Nagel, Alexandra Seceleanu, Adam Van Tuyl and Thanh Vu, “The Waldschmidt constant for squarefree monomial ideals”, arXiv:1508.00477 (2016).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.00477

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2015).
